description: Velocity integration divides by mass but bug multiplies. Velocity commands are ~6x too large (mass=2.3+3.9=6.2), causing immediate saturation and loss of control.
diff:
- lqr_sim_out->SI_v_soll = lqr_sim_out->SI_v_soll_old + lqr_sim_out->LQ_F_soll * (cycletime_secs / (3.9 + params->m_axis));
+ lqr_sim_out->SI_v_soll = lqr_sim_out->SI_v_soll_old + lqr_sim_out->LQ_F_soll * (cycletime_secs * (3.9 + params->m_axis));
